<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="copilot_createFile">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **copilot_createFile**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "file_path": "/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_all_f8_actions.py",
  "relativeWorkspacePath": "extract_all_f8_actions.py"
}
```
Additional data:

```json
{
  "vscodeToolId": "copilot_createFile",
  "isHidden": false
}
```
Result:

```json
{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_all_f8_actions.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_all_f8_actions.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Extract ALL F8 action codes from ALL rooms in ALFRED.1, with surrounding text context.\nAlso maps each action to its handler address via the dispatch table in JUEGO.EXE.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport sys\nimport json\n\nALFRED1 = \"files/ALFRED.1\"\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\n# Dispatch table constants\nTABLE_OFFSET = 0x4C058\nENTRY_SIZE = 6\nNUM_ENTRIES = 116\n\nNUM_ROOMS = 56\nNUM_PAIRS = 13\nDIR_ENTRY_SIZE = 8  # 4 bytes offset + 4 bytes size\n\ndef read_dispatch_table():\n    \"\"\"Read the F8 dispatch table from JUEGO.EXE, return dict: action_id -&gt; ghidra_addr\"\"\"\n    table = {}\n    with open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n        for i in range(NUM_ENTRIES):\n            f.seek(TABLE_OFFSET + i * ENTRY_SIZE)\n            data = f.read(ENTRY_SIZE)\n            if len(data) &lt; 6:\n                break\n            action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0)[0]\n            stored_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 2)[0]\n            ghidra_addr = stored_ptr + 0x10000\n            table[action_id] = ghidra_addr\n    return table\n\ndef read_room_directory():\n    \"\"\"Read the room directory from ALFRED.1\"\"\"\n    rooms = []\n    with open(ALFRED1, \"rb\") as f:\n        for room_idx in range(NUM_ROOMS):\n            pairs = []\n            for pair_idx in range(NUM_PAIRS):\n                offset_in_dir = (room_idx * NUM_PAIRS + pair_idx) * DIR_ENTRY_SIZE\n                f.seek(offset_in_dir)\n                data = f.read(DIR_ENTRY_SIZE)\n                off, size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;II', data, 0)\n                pairs.append((off, size))\n            rooms.append(pairs)\n    return rooms\n\ndef extract_text_around_action(data, action_pos, window=80):\n    \"\"\"Extract readable text around an F8 action code position\"\"\"\n    # Look backwards for text context\n    start = max(0, action_pos - window)\n    end = min(len(data), action_pos + window)\n    \n    chunk = data[start:end]\n    # Extract printable ASCII/Latin-1 text\n    text_parts = []\n    current = []\n    for b in chunk:\n        if 0x20 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7E or 0xA0 &lt;= b &lt;= 0xFF:\n            current.append(chr(b))\n        else:\n            if current:\n                t = ''.join(current).strip()\n                if len(t) &gt; 2:\n                    text_parts.append(t)\n                current = []\n    if current:\n        t = ''.join(current).strip()\n        if len(t) &gt; 2:\n            text_parts.append(t)\n    return ' | '.join(text_parts)\n\ndef find_preceding_text(data, action_pos, max_lookback=300):\n    \"\"\"Find the text line(s) immediately preceding an F8 action code\"\"\"\n    # Walk backwards from action_pos to find text terminated by FD\n    pos = action_pos - 1\n    lines = []\n    \n    while pos &gt;= max(0, action_pos - max_lookback):\n        # Look for FD (end of text) or other control codes that precede text\n        if data[pos] == 0xFD:\n            # Found end-of-text, now read backwards to find start\n            text_end = pos\n            text_start = pos - 1\n            while text_start &gt;= 0 and data[text_start] &gt;= 0x20:\n                text_start -= 1\n            text_start += 1\n            if text_start &lt; text_end:\n                text_bytes = data[text_start:text_end]\n                text = ''.join(chr(b) if (0x20 &lt;= b &lt;= 0x7E or 0xA0 &lt;= b &lt;= 0xFF) else '' for b in text_bytes)\n                text = text.strip()\n                if text:\n                    lines.insert(0, text)\n            if len(lines) &gt;= 2:\n                break\n            pos = text_start - 1\n        else:\n            pos -= 1\n    \n    return ' → '.join(lines) if lines else \"(no preceding text found)\"\n\ndef classify_context(data, action_pos):\n    \"\"\"Try to determine if action is in a description or conversation context\"\"\"\n    # Scan backwards for context markers\n    pos = action_pos - 1\n    while pos &gt;= max(0, action_pos - 500):\n        b = data[pos]\n        if b == 0xFF:\n            return \"description\"\n        if b in (0xFE, 0xFB, 0xF1, 0xFC):\n            return \"conversation\"\n        pos -= 1\n    return \"unknown\"\n\ndef scan_room_for_actions(room_idx, rooms):\n    \"\"\"Scan room text data (Pair 12) for F8 action codes\"\"\"\n    pair12_off, pair12_size = rooms[room_idx][12]\n    if pair12_size == 0:\n        return []\n    \n    actions = []\n    with open(ALFRED1, \"rb\") as f:\n        f.seek(pair12_off)\n        data = f.read(pair12_size)\n    \n    pos = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(data) - 2:\n        if data[pos] == 0xF8:\n            action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, pos + 1)[0]\n            context = find_preceding_text(data, pos)\n            ctx_type = classify_context(data, pos)\n            actions.append({\n                'room': room_idx,\n                'action_id': action_id,\n                'action_hex': f\"0x{action_id:04X}\",\n                'offset_in_pair12': pos,\n                'context_type': ctx_type,\n                'preceding_text': context\n            })\n            pos += 3  # Skip F8 + 2 bytes\n        else:\n            pos += 1\n    \n    return actions\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"=== F8 Action Code Extraction - All Rooms ===\\n\")\n    \n    # Read dispatch table\n    dispatch = read_dispatch_table()\n    print(f\"Dispatch table: {len(dispatch)} entries loaded\\n\")\n    \n    # Read room directory\n    rooms = read_room_directory()\n    \n    all_actions = []\n    \n    for room_idx in range(NUM_ROOMS):\n        actions = scan_room_for_actions(room_idx, rooms)\n        if actions:\n            all_actions.extend(actions)\n    \n    # Print results grouped by room\n    current_room = -1\n    unique_action_ids = set()\n    \n    for a in all_actions:\n        if a['room'] != current_room:\n            current_room = a['room']\n            print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n            print(f\"ROOM {current_room}\")\n            print(f\"{'='*60}\")\n        \n        action_id = a['action_id']\n        unique_action_ids.add(action_id)\n        ghidra_addr = dispatch.get(action_id, None)\n        addr_str = f\"Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05X}\" if ghidra_addr else \"NOT IN TABLE\"\n        \n        print(f\"  ACTION {a['action_hex']} ({action_id:&gt;3d}) [{a['context_type']:&gt;12s}] → {addr_str}\")\n        print(f\"    Text: {a['preceding_text'][:120]}\")\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"SUMMARY\")\n    print(f\"{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Total action references: {len(all_actions)}\")\n    print(f\"Unique action IDs: {len(unique_action_ids)}\")\n    \n    # Print unique actions sorted with their handler addresses\n    print(f\"\\n--- Unique Actions (sorted) ---\")\n    for aid in sorted(unique_action_ids):\n        ghidra_addr = dispatch.get(aid, None)\n        addr_str = f\"0x{ghidra_addr:05X}\" if ghidra_addr else \"NOT IN TABLE\"\n        # Find which rooms reference this action\n        action_rooms = sorted(set(a['room'] for a in all_actions if a['action_id'] == aid))\n        rooms_str = ', '.join(str(r) for r in action_rooms)\n        print(f\"  ACTION 0x{aid:04X} ({aid:&gt;3d}) → {addr_str}  [Rooms: {rooms_str}]\")\n    \n    # Also output JSON for further processing\n    output = {\n        'actions': all_actions,\n        'dispatch_table': {f\"0x{k:04X}\": f\"0x{v:05X}\" for k, v in dispatch.items()},\n        'unique_ids': sorted(unique_action_ids)\n    }\n    with open(\"all_f8_actions.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(output, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(f\"\\nJSON output written to all_f8_actions.json\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

6:\n            break\n        action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0)[0]\n        stored_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 2)[0]\n        ghidra_addr = stored_ptr + 0x10000\n        print(f\"  Entry {i:3d}: ID=0x{action_id:04X} ({action_id:5d})  ptr=0x{stored_ptr:08X}  ghidra=0x{ghidra_addr:05X}  raw={data.hex()}\")\n        # Stop if we hit suspicious data (zeroes or very large IDs)\n        if action_id == 0 and stored_ptr == 0:\n            print(\"  (zero entry, stopping)\")\n            break\n\n# Now search for the actual conversation action handler\n# The F8 actions in conversations (0x0101-0x017F) might use a different dispatch mechanism\n# Let's search for these IDs in the EXE\nprint(\"\\n=== Searching for action ID bytes in JUEGO.EXE ===\")\nwith open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Search for a few known action IDs as 16-bit LE values near table-like structures\ntest_ids = [0x0101, 0x0102, 0x0148, 0x015C, 0x015D, 0x015E, 0x0160, 0x0165]\nfor test_id in test_ids:\n    lo = test_id &amp; 0xFF\n    hi = (test_id &gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xFF\n    pattern = bytes([lo, hi])\n    positions = []\n    pos = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(exe_data):\n        idx = exe_data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if idx == -1:\n            break\n        positions.append(idx)\n        pos = idx + 1\n    print(f\"  ID 0x{test_id:04X}: found at {len(positions)} positions\")\n    # Show first few\n    for p in positions[:5]:\n        context = exe_data[p:p+8].hex()\n        ghidra_equiv = p + 0x10000 - 0x14200\n        if ghidra_equiv &gt; 0:\n            print(f\"    file 0x{p:06X} (ghidra ~0x{p - 0x14200 + 0x10000:05X}): {context}\")\n\n# Let's also look for what process_f8_dispatch actually does\n# Try to find a switch/jump table pattern for these IDs\nprint(\"\\n=== Looking for sequential action IDs (table pattern) ===\")\n# Search for 0x01 0x01 followed by ptr-like bytes, then 0x02 0x01\nfor off in range(len(exe_data) - 12):\n    w1 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', exe_data, off)[0]\n    w2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', exe_data, off + 6)[0]\n    if w1 == 0x0101 and w2 == 0x0102:\n        # Potential table with sequential IDs\n        print(f\"  Found 0x0101 followed by 0x0102 at file offset 0x{off:06X}\")\n        # Dump a few entries\n        for i in range(min(10, (len(exe_data) - off) // 6)):\n            entry = exe_data[off + i*6:off + i*6 + 6]\n            if len(entry) &lt; 6:\n                break\n            aid = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', entry, 0)[0]\n            ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', entry, 2)[0]\n            ga = ptr + 0x10000\n            print(f\"    Entry {i}: ID=0x{aid:04X} ptr=0x{ptr:08X} ghidra=0x{ga:05X}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Dump the REAL F8 conversation action dispatch table found at file offset 0x4B058.\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nTABLE_OFFSET = 0x4B058  # The correct table offset\nENTRY_SIZE = 6\n\nprint(\"=== F8 Conversation Action Dispatch Table (file 0x4B058) ===\")\nentries = []\nwith open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n    for i in range(200):  # Read up to 200 entries to find the end\n        f.seek(TABLE_OFFSET + i * ENTRY_SIZE)\n        data = f.read(ENTRY_SIZE)\n        if len(data) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        action_id = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0)[0]\n        stored_ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 2)[0]\n        ghidra_addr = stored_ptr + 0x10000\n        \n        # Stop conditions: zero entry, or ID out of expected range\n        if action_id == 0 and stored_ptr == 0:\n            print(f\"  Entry {i}: ZERO - end of table\")\n            break\n        if action_id &lt; 0x0100 or action_id &gt; 0x0200:\n            print(f\"  Entry {i}: ID=0x{action_id:04X} - out of range, end of table\")\n            # Print a couple more to confirm\n            for j in range(3):\n                f.seek(TABLE_OFFSET + (i+j+1) * ENTRY_SIZE)\n                d2 = f.read(6)\n                a2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', d2, 0)[0]\n                p2 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', d2, 2)[0]\n                print(f\"    +{j+1}: ID=0x{a2:04X} ptr=0x{p2:08X}\")\n            break\n            \n        entries.append((action_id, ghidra_addr))\n        print(f\"  Entry {i:3d}: ID=0x{action_id:04X} ({action_id:3d}) → Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05X}\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nTotal entries: {len(entries)}\")\nprint(f\"Action ID range: 0x{min(e[0] for e in entries):04X} - 0x{max(e[0] for e in entries):04X}\")\n\n# Now check which conversation actions from our extraction are in this table\nconv_actions = [\n    0x0101, 0x0102, 0x0103, 0x0104, 0x0105, 0x0106, 0x0107, 0x0108,\n    0x010B, 0x010C, 0x010E, 0x010F, 0x0110, 0x0111, 0x0112, 0x0113,\n    0x0114, 0x0115, 0x0116, 0x0117, 0x0118, 0x0119, 0x011A, 0x011D,\n    0x011E, 0x011F, 0x0120, 0x0121, 0x0122, 0x0123, 0x0124, 0x0125,\n    0x0126, 0x0127, 0x0129, 0x0133, 0x0134, 0x0139, 0x013A, 0x013C,\n    0x013D, 0x013E, 0x013F, 0x0140, 0x0141, 0x0142, 0x0143, 0x0144,\n    0x0145, 0x0146, 0x0147, 0x0148, 0x0149, 0x014A, 0x014B, 0x014C,\n    0x014D, 0x014E, 0x014F, 0x0150, 0x0151, 0x0152, 0x0153, 0x0154,\n    0x0155, 0x0156, 0x0157, 0x0158, 0x0159, 0x015A, 0x015B, 0x015C,\n    0x015D, 0x015E, 0x015F, 0x0160, 0x0161, 0x0162, 0x0163, 0x0164,\n    0x0165, 0x0166, 0x0167, 0x0168, 0x0169, 0x016A, 0x016B, 0x016C,\n    0x016D, 0x016E, 0x016F, 0x0170, 0x0171, 0x0172, 0x0173, 0x0174,\n    0x0175, 0x0176, 0x0177, 0x0178, 0x0179, 0x017A, 0x017F\n]\n\ntable_dict = {e[0]: e[1] for e in entries}\nprint(f\"\\n=== Coverage check ===\")\nfound = 0\nmissing = 0\nfor aid in sorted(conv_actions):\n    if aid in table_dict:\n        found += 1\n    else:\n        missing += 1\n        print(f\"  MISSING from table: 0x{aid:04X} ({aid})\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nFound: {found}/{len(conv_actions)}, Missing: {missing}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find the correct file-to-Ghidra offset mapping by searching for known byte patterns.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\n# From Batch 1: Action 0x0101 at Ghidra 0x20C76 starts with:\n#   push 0xc        = 6A 0C\n#   call 0x2A218    = E8 &lt;rel32&gt;  where rel32 = 0x2A218 - (0x20C76 + 2 + 5) = 0x2A218 - 0x20C7B\n# Wait, push 0xc is 2 bytes (6A 0C), call is at 0x20C78, so:\n#   rel32 = 0x2A218 - (0x20C78 + 5) = 0x2A218 - 0x20C7D = 0x959B\n# So the byte sequence at ghidra 0x20C76 should be: 6A 0C E8 9B 95 00 00\n\n# Also: Action 0x0112 at Ghidra 0x213BB starts with:\n#   push 0xc        = 6A 0C\n#   call 0x2A218    = E8 &lt;rel32&gt;  where rel32 = 0x2A218 - (0x213BB + 2 + 5) = 0x2A218 - 0x213C2 = 0x8E56\n# So bytes: 6A 0C E8 56 8E 00 00\n\n# Search for these byte patterns in the EXE\npatterns = {\n    \"action_0101_push_call\": bytes([0x6A, 0x0C, 0xE8, 0x9B, 0x95, 0x00, 0x00]),\n    \"action_0112_push_call\": bytes([0x6A, 0x0C, 0xE8, 0x56, 0x8E, 0x00, 0x00]),\n}\n\nwith open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint(f\"JUEGO.EXE size: {len(data)} (0x{len(data):X})\")\nprint()\n\nfor name, pattern in patterns.items():\n    print(f\"Searching for {name}: {pattern.hex()}\")\n    pos = 0\n    while True:\n        idx = data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if idx == -1:\n            break\n        # Expected ghidra_addr for action_0101 = 0x20C76\n        # Expected ghidra_addr for action_0112 = 0x213BB\n        if \"0101\" in name:\n            expected_ghidra = 0x20C76\n        else:\n            expected_ghidra = 0x213BB\n        file_to_ghidra_delta = expected_ghidra - idx\n        print(f\"  Found at file offset 0x{idx:X}\")\n        print(f\"  Delta (ghidra - file): 0x{file_to_ghidra_delta:X} ({file_to_ghidra_delta})\")\n        pos = idx + 1\n    print()\n\n# Also try to find the LE header to understand the mapping\nprint(\"=== Checking EXE header ===\")\nmz_sig = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0)[0]\nprint(f\"MZ signature: 0x{mz_sig:04X} ({'MZ' if mz_sig == 0x5A4D else 'NOT MZ'})\")\n\n# For MZ EXE, the new header offset is at offset 0x3C\nif mz_sig == 0x5A4D:\n    new_header_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 0x3C)[0]\n    print(f\"New header offset (e_lfanew): 0x{new_header_off:X}\")\n    if new_header_off &lt; len(data):\n        sig = data[new_header_off:new_header_off+2]\n        print(f\"New header signature: {sig.hex()} ({sig})\")\n        if sig == b'LE':\n            print(\"  → LE (Linear Executable) format\")\n            # LE header: object table offset at +0x40, object count at +0x44\n            obj_table_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, new_header_off + 0x40)[0]\n            obj_count = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, new_header_off + 0x44)[0]\n            data_pages_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, new_header_off + 0x80)[0]\n            print(f\"  Object table offset (from LE header): 0x{obj_table_off:X}\")\n            print(f\"  Object count: {obj_count}\")\n            print(f\"  Data pages offset: 0x{data_pages_off:X}\")\n            \n            # Read each object entry (24 bytes each)\n            abs_obj_table = new_header_off + obj_table_off\n            for i in range(min(obj_count, 10)):\n                entry_off = abs_obj_table + i * 24\n                vsize = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off)[0]\n                reloc_base = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 4)[0]\n                flags = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 8)[0]\n                page_map_idx = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 12)[0]\n                page_map_entries = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 16)[0]\n                reserved = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, entry_off + 20)[0]\n                print(f\"  Object {i+1}: vsize=0x{vsize:X}, reloc_base=0x{reloc_base:X}, flags=0x{flags:X}, page_map_idx={page_map_idx}, page_entries={page_map_entries}\")\n",

}

  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_mapping2.py)",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find the correct code mapping in the LE executable.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\nwith open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# LE header info\nLE_HEADER = 0x2A50\nDATA_PAGES_OFF = 0x14200\nOBJ1_RELOC_BASE = 0x10000\n\n# Try different mappings\n# Mapping 1: file_offset = DATA_PAGES_OFF + (ghidra_addr - OBJ1_RELOC_BASE)\n# Mapping 2: file_offset = ghidra_addr - OBJ1_RELOC_BASE (direct)\n# Mapping 3: Look at LE page map table\n\n# Read the LE header more carefully\npage_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, LE_HEADER + 0x28)[0]\npage_shift = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, LE_HEADER + 0x2C)[0]  # page offset shift\nfixup_page_table = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, LE_HEADER + 0x68)[0]\npage_map_off = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, LE_HEADER + 0x48)[0]\nnum_pages = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, LE_HEADER + 0x18)[0]\n\nprint(f\"LE header at: 0x{LE_HEADER:X}\")\nprint(f\"Page size: 0x{page_size:X} ({page_size})\")\nprint(f\"Page shift: {page_shift}\")\nprint(f\"Data pages offset: 0x{DATA_PAGES_OFF:X}\")\nprint(f\"Page map offset (from LE header): 0x{page_map_off:X}\")\nprint(f\"Number of pages: {num_pages}\")\nprint()\n\n# The LE Object Page Map is at LE_HEADER + page_map_off  \n# Each entry: 3 bytes (high page#: 2 bytes, flags: 1 byte) for DOS/4GW LE\n# Actually the structure is: 4 bytes per entry (PageDataOffset:24, Flags:8) or similar\n\n# Let me just try the simplest approach: data_pages_off + virtual_offset\n# and search for the known pattern\n\ntarget_ghidra = 0x20C76  # action 0x0101\npattern = bytes([0x6A, 0x0C])  # push 0xc\n\n# Try mapping: file = DATA_PAGES_OFF + (ghidra - OBJ1_RELOC_BASE)\nfor delta_name, delta in [\n    (\"data_pages + voff\", DATA_PAGES_OFF),\n    (\"direct voff\", 0),\n    (\"header + voff\", LE_HEADER),\n]:\n    file_off = delta + (target_ghidra - OBJ1_RELOC_BASE)\n    if 0 &lt;= file_off &lt; len(data) - 2:\n        got = data[file_off:file_off+20]\n        print(f\"Mapping '{delta_name}': 0x{target_ghidra:X} → file 0x{file_off:X}\")\n        print(f\"  Bytes: {got.hex()}\")\n        if got[:2] == pattern:\n            # Also check: the next 5 bytes should be E8 xx xx xx xx (call)\n            if got[2] == 0xE8:\n                rel32 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', got, 3)[0]\n                call_target = target_ghidra + 2 + 5 + rel32\n                print(f\"  ✓ MATCH! push 0xc, call 0x{call_target:X}\")\n            else:\n                print(f\"  Push 0xc found but next is 0x{got[2]:02X} not 0xE8\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  No match\")\n    print()\n\n# Also: search for \"6a 0c e8\" throughout the file to find all call patterns\nprint(\"=== Searching for all '6A 0C E8' in file ===\")\nsearch = bytes([0x6A, 0x0C, 0xE8])\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile count &lt; 30:\n    idx = data.find(search, pos)\n    if idx == -1:\n        break\n    rel32 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, idx + 3)[0]\n    # For each potential mapping, what would the ghidra address and call target be?\n    for delta_name, delta in [(\"dp+voff\", DATA_PAGES_OFF)]:\n        ghidra_of_push = idx - delta + OBJ1_RELOC_BASE\n        call_insn_addr = ghidra_of_push + 2  # address of E8\n        call_target = call_insn_addr + 5 + rel32\n        if call_target == 0x2A218:  # get_current_room_number\n            print(f\"  *** FOUND at file 0x{idx:X}: push 0xc; call get_current_room_number → ghidra 0x{ghidra_of_push:X}\")\n            count += 100  # found it!\n    pos = idx + 1\n    count += 1\n\n# Try without delta (file = ghidra - 0x10000)  \nprint(\"\\n=== Try mapping: file = ghidra - 0x10000 ===\")\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile count &lt; 30:\n    idx = data.find(search, pos)\n    if idx == -1:\n        break\n    rel32 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, idx + 3)[0]\n    ghidra_of_push = idx + OBJ1_RELOC_BASE\n    call_target = ghidra_of_push + 2 + 5 + rel32\n    if call_target == 0x2A218:\n        print(f\"  *** FOUND at file 0x{idx:X}: push 0xc; call get_current_room_number → ghidra 0x{ghidra_of_push:X}\")\n    pos = idx + 1\n    count += 1\n\n# Try with various offsets\nprint(\"\\n=== Brute-force: search all 6A 0C E8 and check call target ===\")\npos = 0\nfound_offsets = []\nwhile True:\n    idx = data.find(search, pos)\n    if idx == -1:\n        break\n    rel32 = struct.unpack_from('&lt;i', data, idx + 3)[0]\n    # call target = (idx + 2 + 5 + base_delta) + rel32 should equal 0x2A218\n    # So base_delta = 0x2A218 - rel32 - (idx + 7)\n    needed_base = 0x2A218 - rel32 - (idx + 7)\n    if 0 &lt;= needed_base &lt;= 0x20000:\n        ghidra_addr = idx + needed_base\n        # The push value is the second byte\n        push_val = data[idx+1]\n        found_offsets.append((idx, needed_base, ghidra_addr, push_val))\n    pos = idx + 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(found_offsets)} matches where call target = get_current_room_number\")\nfor idx, base, ghidra, push_val in found_offsets[:20]:\n    print(f\"  file 0x{idx:X}, base_needed=0x{base:X}, ghidra=0x{ghidra:X}, push 0x{push_val:X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble additional code blocks needed for Batch 2 analysis.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\n\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOUTPUT = \"batch2_extra.txt\"\n\nKNOWN_FUNCS = {\n    0x2A218: \"get_current_room_number\",\n    0x2A258: \"wait_or_process_input\",\n    0x1B666: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x1B1A2: \"play_get_naked_easter_egg\",\n    0x19F2A: \"render_menu_screen\",\n    0x1B4A3: \"load_room_graphics_and_palette_dynamic\",\n    0x19DC8: \"draw_cursor_to_screen\",\n    0x28D32: \"play_cd_audio_track\",\n    0x2942D: \"fade_cd_audio\",\n    0x28FD5: \"set_vga_mode\",\n    0x15E4C: \"render_scene\",\n    0x244E8: \"set_vga_palette\",\n    0x29037: \"init_or_stop_sound\",\n    0x24157: \"process_inventory_action\",\n    0x1625D: \"present_frame_to_screen\",\n    0x15258: \"wait_for_input_buffer_clear\",\n    0x25E90: \"allocate_memory\",\n    0x2A342: \"file_seek\",\n    0x2A43E: \"file_read\",\n    0x2A66B: \"memcpy_wrapper\",\n    0x2A6B7: \"write_data_to_alfred1\",\n    0x1A9CF: \"render_character_to_screen\",\n    0x1BD53: \"animate_character\",\n    0x26FAB: \"cleanup_after_inventory\",\n    0x15DD4: \"copy_background_to_front_buffer\",\n    0x2B12F: \"random_number_generator\",\n    0x213D3: \"shared_tail_update_conv_state\",\n    0x152F5: \"unknown_152f5\",\n    0x1B83A: \"unknown_1b83a\",\n    0x1B8B3: \"unknown_1b8b3\",\n    0x1B94C: \"unknown_1b94c\",\n}\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (ghidra_addr - 0x10000)\n\ndef disasm_block(exe_data, ghidra_addr, max_bytes=256, stop_at_ret=True, max_rets=1):\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    file_off = ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr)\n    raw = exe_data[file_off:file_off + max_bytes]\n    \n    lines = []\n    ret_count = 0\n    for insn in md.disasm(raw, ghidra_addr):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in insn.bytes)\n        line = f\"  {insn.address:05X}: {hex_bytes:&lt;30s} {insn.mnemonic} {insn.op_str}\"\n        if insn.mnemonic in ('call', 'jmp') and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        lines.append(line)\n        if insn.mnemonic == 'ret':\n            ret_count += 1\n            if ret_count &gt;= max_rets and stop_at_ret:\n                break\n        if insn.mnemonic == 'jmp' and stop_at_ret and max_rets == 1:\n            break\n    return lines\n\ndef main():\n    with open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n        exe_data = f.read()\n    \n    out = []\n    \n    # 1. Shared tail at 0x213CC (jumped to by actions 275, 276)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"SHARED TAIL at 0x213CC (jumped to by actions 275, 276)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x213CC, max_bytes=64):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 2. Shared tail at 0x213D3 (from batch 1, for reference)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"SHARED TAIL at 0x213D3 (from batch 1)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x213D3, max_bytes=32):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 3. Jump target 0x2177E (end of action 285 main path)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x2177E (tail of action 285)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x2177E, max_bytes=64):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 4. Jump target 0x21783 (conditional jump from 285 if [0x95e6] != 0)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x21783 (action 285, already-arrested path)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x21783, max_bytes=32):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 5. Jump target 0x21BC0 (from action 290)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x21BC0 (tail of action 290)\")  \n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x21BC0, max_bytes=32):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 6. Jump target 0x21BC5 (action 290 skip path)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x21BC5 (action 290, count&lt;4 skip)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x21BC5, max_bytes=32):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 7. Jump target 0x11E1D (shared dialog handler)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x11E1D (shared dialog handler)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x11E1D, max_bytes=64):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 8. Jump target 0x20446 (from extended listing)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x20446 (jumped from extended handler)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x20446, max_bytes=64):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 9. Full disassembly of action 285 extended area (0x2151D to ~0x21787)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"FULL ACTION 285 (0x2151D) - ALL PATHS\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x2151D, max_bytes=700, stop_at_ret=False, max_rets=99):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # 10. Code between 0x2170F and 0x21787 (continuation of action 285 extended / action 292 area)\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    out.append(\"CODE at 0x2170F (continuation of handler area)\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    for line in disasm_block(exe_data, 0x2170F, max_bytes=200, stop_at_ret=True, max_rets=2):\n        out.append(line)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    result = '\\n'.join(out)\n    with open(OUTPUT, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(result)\n    print(f\"Written {len(out)} lines to {OUTPUT}\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble F8 action handlers (Batch 3) from JUEGO.EXE using capstone.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, \"shared_dialog_handler\",\n    0x21BC0: \"shared_conv_tail_21bc0\",\n    0x20446: \"shared_conv_tail_20446\",\n    0x1B83A: \"remove_inventory_item\",\n    0x1B8B3: \"fade_palette_to_black\",\n    0x1B94C: \"play_arrest_cutscene\",\n    0x152F5: \"load_room_and_init_alfred\",\n    0x2151D: \"shared_arrest_jail_handler\",\n    0x1A683: \"trigger_dialog_or_action\",\n    0x17AAA: \"display_text_with_voice\",\n    0x1AD9A: \"render_action_popup_menu\",\n    0x1A0D9: \"display_text_description\",\n}\n\n# Batch 3 handlers to disassemble\nHANDLERS = [\n    (0x2163A, 0x0125, 293, \"action_293\"),\n    (0x216F5, 0x0126, 294, \"action_294\"),\n    (0x218CC, 0x0127, 295, \"action_295\"),\n    (0x218F3, 0x0128, 296, \"action_296\"),\n    (0x21910, 0x0129, 297, \"action_297\"),\n    (0x219A8, 0x012A, 298, \"action_298\"),\n    (0x219D4, 0x012B, 299, \"action_299\"),\n    (0x219FB, 0x012C, 300, \"action_300\"),\n    (0x21A18, 0x012D, 301, \"action_301\"),\n    (0x21A2B, 0x012E, 302, \"action_302\"),\n    (0x21A3E, 0x012F, 303, \"action_303\"),\n    (0x21A51, 0x0130, 304, \"action_304\"),\n    (0x21A64, 0x0131, 305, \"action_305\"),\n    (0x21A77, 0x0132, 306, \"action_306\"),\n    (0x21A8A, 0x0133, 307, \"action_307\"),\n]\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr):\n    \"\"\"Convert Ghidra address to file offset in JUEGO.EXE\"\"\"\n    return 0x14200 + (ghidra_addr - 0x10000)\n\ndef disassemble_handler(data, ghidra_base, max_bytes=512, stop_at_first_ret=True, max_rets=1):\n    \"\"\"Disassemble handler code.\"\"\"\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    \n    lines = []\n    ret_count = 0\n    for insn in md.disasm(data[:max_bytes], ghidra_base):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in insn.bytes)\n        line = f\"  {insn.address:05X}: {hex_bytes:&lt;30s} {insn.mnemonic} {insn.op_str}\"\n        \n        # Annotate known targets for call/jmp\n        if insn.mnemonic in ('call', 'jmp') and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        \n        # Annotate conditional jumps too\n        if insn.mnemonic.startswith('j') and insn.mnemonic not in ('jmp',) and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        \n        lines.append(line)\n        \n        if insn.mnemonic == 'ret' or insn.mnemonic == 'retf':\n            ret_count += 1\n            if stop_at_first_ret and ret_count &gt;= max_rets:\n                break\n        if insn.mnemonic == 'jmp':\n            # Check if the jump target is a known shared tail - stop after\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                # If jumping to known function or shared tail, stop\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    break\n                # If jumping forward past our current range, likely a tail call\n                if target &gt; insn.address + 256:\n                    break\n                # If jumping backward before our base, it's a tail call\n                if target &lt; ghidra_base:\n                    break\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n            # If jmp to nearby address, continue disassembling\n            # (it could be internal control flow)\n            break\n    \n    return lines\n\ndef disassemble_extended(data, ghidra_base, max_bytes=1024, max_rets=5):\n    \"\"\"Extended disassembly - don't stop at first ret/jmp.\"\"\"\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    \n    lines = []\n    ret_count = 0\n    for insn in md.disasm(data[:max_bytes], ghidra_base):\n 'jmp') and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        \n        if insn.mnemonic.startswith('j') and insn.mnemonic not in ('jmp',) and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        \n        lines.append(line)\n        \n        if insn.mnemonic == 'ret':\n            ret_count += 1\n            if ret_count &gt;= max_rets:\n                break\n    \n    return lines\n\ndef main():\n    with open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n        exe_data = f.read()\n    \n    output_lines = []\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    output_lines.append(\"F8 ACTION HANDLER BATCH 3 - DISASSEMBLY\")\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 80)\n    output_lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    for ghidra_addr, action_hex, action_dec, label in HANDLERS:\n        file_offset = ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr)\n        \n        # Read up to 512 bytes from this offset\n        raw = exe_data[file_offset:file_offset + 512]\n        \n        output_lines.append(\"-\" * 70)\n        output_lines.append(f\"ACTION 0x{action_hex:04X} ({action_dec}) @ Ghidra 0x{ghidra_addr:05X} (file 0x{file_offset:05X})\")\n        output_lines.append(f\"Label: {label}\")\n        output_lines.append(f\"Raw bytes (first 64): {raw[:64].hex()}\")\n        output_lines.append(\"\")\n        \n        asm_lines = disassemble_handler(raw, ghidra_addr)\n        for line in asm_lines:\n            output_lines.append(line)\n        \n        output_lines.append(\"\")\n        \n        # For handlers that are potentially large (293, 294, 297), also do extended\n        if ghidra_addr in (0x2163A, 0x216F5, 0x21910):\n            output_lines.append(\"  [Extended disassembly]\")\n            ext_lines = disassemble_extended(raw, ghidra_addr, max_bytes=512, max_rets=3)\n            output_lines.append(f\"  [{len(ext_lines)} instructions, extended view]\")\n            for line in ext_lines:\n                output_lines.append(line)\n            output_lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Also disassemble any shared tails we might encounter\n    # Check addresses 0x21BC0-0x21BC7 and 0x21BC8+ for shared code\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    output_lines.append(\"SHARED CODE BLOCKS REFERENCED BY BATCH 3\")\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    shared_blocks = [\n        (0x21BC0, \"shared_conv_tail_21bc0\"),\n        (0x21BC8, \"code_after_shared_tail\"),\n        (0x21A9D, \"code_at_21A9D\"),\n        (0x21B11, \"code_at_21B11_action_308_boundary\"),\n    ]\n    \n    for      ext_lines = disassemble_extended(raw, addr, max_bytes=64, max_rets=2)\n        for line in ext_lines:\n            output_lines.append(line)\n    \n    output_lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    result \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOUTPUT = \"batch4_extra.txt\"\n\nKNOWN_FUNCS = {\n    0x2A218: \"get_current_room_number\",\n    0x2A258: \"wait_or_process_input\",\n    0x1B666: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x1B1A2: \"play_get_naked_easter_egg\",\n    0x19F2A: \"render_menu_screen\",\n    0x1B4A3: \"load_room_graphics_and_palette_dynamic\",\n    0x19DC8: \"draw_cursor_to_screen\",\n    0x28D32: 0x24157: \"process_inventory_action\",\n    0x1625D: \"present_frame_to_screen\",\n    0x15258: \"wait_for_input_buffer_clear\",\n    0x25E90: \"allocate_memory\",\n    0x2A342: \"file_seek\",\n    0x2A43E: \"file_read\",\n    0x2A66B: \"memcpy_wrapper\",\n    0x2A6B7: \"write_data_to_alfred1\",\n    0x1A9CF: \"render_character_to_screen\",\n    0x1BD53: \"animate_character\",\n    0x26FAB: \"cleanup_after_inventory\",\n    0x15DD4: \"copy_background_to_front_buffer\",\n    0x2B12F: \"random_number_generator\",\n    0x1B83A: \"remove_inventory_item\",\n    0x1B8B3: \"fade_palette_to_black\",\n    0x1B94C: \"play_arrest_cutscene\",\n    0x152F5: \"load_room_and_init_alfred\",\n    0x2151D: \"shared_arrest_jail_handler\",\n    0x1A683: \"trigger_dialog_or_action\",\n    0x17AAA: \"walk_to_target_and_execute_queued_action\",\n    0x18562: \"room_specific_action_dispatcher\",\n    0x27CE1: \"play_ambient_sound\",\n    0x25487: \"display_text_with_voice\",\n    0x1BADF: \"check_item_in_inventory\",\n    0x1B666: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x217A9: \"shared_inventory_tail\",\n}\n\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (ghidra_addr - 0x10000)\n\n\ndef disassemble(data, base, max_bytes=256, max_rets=3):\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    lines = []\n    ret_count = 0\n    for insn in md.disasm(data[:max_bytes], base):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in insn.bytes)\n        line = f\"  {insn.address:05X}: {hex_bytes:&lt;30s} {insn.mnemonic} {insn.op_str}\"\n        if insn.mnemonic in ('call', 'jmp') and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        if insn.mnemonic.startswith('j') and insn.mnemonic != 'jmp' and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        lines.append(line)\n        if insn.mnemonic == 'ret':\n            ret_count += 1\n            if ret_count &gt;= max_rets:\n                break\n    return lines\n\n\ndef main():\n    with open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n        exe_data = f.read()\n\n    output_lines = []\n\n    blocks = [\n        (0x221F7, \"jump target from action_308\", 128, 2),\n        (0x150ED, \"jump target from action_324 (free_memory?)\", 64, 2),\n        (0x21BB4, \"mid-handler code (action_319 shared)\", 32, 1),\n        (0x21E68, \"shared conv tail 21e68\", 16, 1),\n        (0x21E6D, \"shared skip-conv tail 21e6d\", 8, 1),\n    ]\n\n    for addr, label, size, max_rets in blocks:\n        file_offset = ghidra_to_file(addr)\n        raw = exe_data[file_offset:file_offset + size]\n        output_lines.append(f\"\\n--- {label} @ 0x{addr:05X} ---\")\n        lines = disassemble(raw, addr, max_bytes=size, max_rets=max_rets)\n        for line in lines:\n            output_lines.append(line)\n        output_lines.append(\"\")\n\n    result = '\\n'.join(output_lines)\n    with open(OUTPUT, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(result)\n    print(result)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble target at 0x1B723 and 0x221BD-0x221F7 range.\"\"\"\nimport struct\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\n\nJUEGO = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOUTPUT = \"batch4_extra2.txt\"\n\nKNOWN_FUNCS = {\n    0x2A218: \"get_current_room_number\",\n    0x2A258: \"wait_or_process_input\",\n    0x1B666: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x29037: \"init_or_stop_sound\",\n    0x24157: \"process_inventory_action\",\n    0x1625D: \"present_frame_to_screen\",\n    0x25E90: \"allocate_memory\",\n    0x2A342: \"file_seek\",\n    0x2A43E: \"file_read\",\n    0x2A66B: \"memcpy_wrapper\",\n    0x2A6B7: \"write_data_to_alfred1\",\n    0x1B83A: \"remove_inventory_item\",\n    0x15DD4: \"copy_background_to_front_buffer\",\n    0x2B12F: \"random_number_generator\",\n    0x152F5: \"load_room_and_init_alfred\",\n    0x27CE1: \"play_ambient_sound\",\n    0x25487: \"display_text_with_voice\",\n    0x1BADF: \"check_item_in_inventory\",\n    0x2A60D: \"play_sound\",\n}\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr):\n    return 0x14200 + (ghidra_addr - 0x10000)\n\ndef disassemble(data, base, max_bytes=256, max_rets=3):\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    lines = []\n    ret_count = 0\n    for insn in md.disasm(data[:max_bytes], base):\n        hex_bytes = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in insn.bytes)\n        line = f\"  {insn.address:05X}: {hex_bytes:&lt;30s} {insn.mnemonic} {insn.op_str}\"\n        if insn.mnemonic in ('call', 'jmp') and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        if insn.mnemonic.startswith('j') and insn.mnemonic != 'jmp' and insn.op_str.startswith('0x'):\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 16)\n                if target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    line += f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n                else:\n                    line += f\"  ; → 0x{target:05X}\"\n            except ValueError:\n                pass\n        lines.append(line)\n        if insn.mnemonic == 'ret':\n            ret_count += 1\n            if ret_count &gt;= max_rets:\n                break\n    return lines\n\ndef main():\n    with open(JUEGO, \"rb\") as f:\n        exe_data = f.read()\n\n    output_lines = []\n\n    blocks = [\n        (0x1B723, \"call target from 0x221F7 (post-conversation?)\", 256, 3),\n        (0x221B0, \"context around 0x221BD-0x221F7\", 128, 2),\n    ]\n\n    for addr, label, size, max_rets in blocks:\n        file_offset = ghidra_to_file(addr)\n        raw = exe_data[file_offset:file_offset + size]\n        output_lines.append(f\"\\n--- {label} @ 0x{addr:05X} ---\")\n        lines = disassemble(raw, addr, max_bytes=size, max_rets=max_rets)\n        for line in lines:\n            output_lines.append(line)\n        output_lines.append(\"\")\n\n    result = '\\n'.join(output_lines)\n    with open(OUTPUT, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(result)\n    print(result)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/disasm_batch5.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/disasm_batch5.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble F8 action handlers - Batch 5 (actions 328-342)\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\ntry:\n    from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\nexcept ImportError:\n    print(\"ERROR: capstone not installed. Run: pip3 install capstone\")\n    sys.exit(1)\n\nEXE_PATH = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\n# Ghidra address to file offset\ndef ghidra_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\n# Known function names\nKNOWN_FUNCS = {\n    0x2A258: \"wait_or_process_input\",\n    0x2BA42: \"update_conversation_state\",\n    0x29037: \"init_or_stop_sound\",\n    0x2B12F: \"random_number_generator\",\n    0x15DD4: \"copy_background_to_front_buffer\",\n    0x1625D: \"present_frame_to_screen\",\n    0x27CE1: \"play_ambient_sound\",\n    0x25487: \"display_text_with_voice\",\n    0x1BADF: \"check_item_in_inventory\",\n    0x2A60D: \"play_sound\",\n    0x1B723: \"setup_npc_conversation_text\",\n    0x1BB2F: \"process_inventory_action\",\n    0x11E1D: \"shared_dialog_handler\",\n}\n\n# Batch 5 addresses\nHANDLERS = [\n    (0x21D74, 0x0148, 328),\n    (0x21D91, 0x0149, 329),\n    (0x21DA3, 0x014A, 330),\n    (0x21DB7, 0x014B, 331),\n    (0x21DCB, 0x014C, 332),\n    (0x21DED, 0x014D, 333),\n    (0x21E01, 0x014E, 334),\n    (0x21E28, 0x014F, 335),\n    (0x21E3C, 0x0150, 336),\n    (0x21E50, 0x0151, 337),\n    (0x21E70, 0x0152, 338),\n    (0x21E83, 0x0153, 339),\n    (0x21E96, 0x0154, 340),\n    (0x21EA9, 0x0155, 341),\n    (0x21EBC, 0x0156, 342),\n]\n\ndef resolve_call_target(addr):\n    \"\"\"Try to resolve a call/jmp target to a known function name.\"\"\"\n    if addr in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n        return KNOWN_FUNCS[addr]\n    return f\"FUN_{addr:05x}\"\n\ndef disasm_handler(data, ghidra_addr, max_bytes=128):\n    \"\"\"Disassemble from ghidra_addr, stopping at ret or unconditional jmp.\"\"\"\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    md.detail = True\n    \n    file_off = ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr)\n    code = data[file_off:file_off + max_bytes]\n    \n    lines = []\n    for insn in md.disasm(code, ghidra_addr):\n        # Resolve call/jmp targets\n        comment = \"\"\n        if insn.mnemonic in (\"call\", \"jmp\"):\n            # Try to parse target address from operand\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 0) if insn.op_str.startswith(\"0x\") else None\n                if target is None and insn.op_str.lstrip(\"-\").isdigit():\n                    target = int(insn.op_str)\n                if target and target in KNOWN_FUNCS:\n                    comment = f\"  ; → {KNOWN_FUNCS[target]}\"\n            except (ValueError, TypeError):\n                pass\n        \n        line = f\"{insn.address:05x}: {insn.mnemonic:8s} {insn.op_str}\"\n        if comment:\n            line += comment\n        lines.append(line)\n        \n        # Stop at ret or unconditional jmp (not conditional)\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"ret\" or insn.mnemonic == \"retf\":\n            break\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"jmp\" and not insn.op_str.startswith(\"0x21\"):\n            # far jump - likely tail call to known func\n            break\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"jmp\":\n            # Near jmp within handler area - might be a shared tail\n            # Continue disassembly at target\n            try:\n                target = int(insn.op_str, 0)\n                if 0x21D00 &lt;= target &lt;= 0x22200:\n                    # It's a near jump to another handler or shared code\n                    # Disassemble the target too\n                    target_off = ghidra_to_file(target)\n                    target_code = data[target_off:target_off + 64]\n                    lines.append(f\"  ; --- jump target at {target:05x} ---\")\n                    for insn2 in md.disasm(target_code, target):\n                        line2 = f\"{insn2.address:05x}: {insn2.mnemonic:8s} {insn2.op_str}\"\n                        #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble supplementary code blocks for Batch 5 analysis\"\"\"\nimport struct\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\n\nEXE = \"files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n\ndef ghidra_to_file(addr):\n    return addr - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n\ndef disasm_at(data, ghidra_addr, max_insns=20):\n    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n    off = ghidra_to_file(ghidra_addr)\n    code = data[off:off+80]\n    lines = []\n    for insn in md.disasm(code, ghidra_addr):\n        lines.append(f\"{insn.address:05x}: {insn.mnemonic:8s} {insn.op_str}\")\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"ret\":\n            break\n        if insn.mnemonic == \"jmp\":\n            break\n        if len(lines) &gt;= max_insns:\n            break\n    return lines\n\nwith open(EXE, \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nout = []\n\n# Code at 0x217a9 (jmp target from action 334)\nout.append(\"=== Code at 0x217a9 (jmp target from action 334) ===\")\nfor l in disasm_at(data, 0x217a9):\n    out.append(l)\n\nout.append(\"\")\n\n# Code at 0x21da2 (jne target from action 332 - this is the ret of action 329)\nout.append(\"=== Code at 0x21da2 (jne target from action 332) ===\")\nfor l in disasm_at(data, 0x21da2):\n    out.append(l)\n\nout.append(\"\")\n\n# Check what 0x95e8 is by looking at Ghidra xrefs\nout.append(\"=== Checking [0x95e8] references in EXE ===\")\npattern = b\"\\xe8\\x95\\x00\\x00\"\ncount = 0\nfor i in range(len(data) - 4):\n    if data[i:i+4] == pattern:\n        ghidra = i - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n        ctx = data[max(0,i-6):i+6]\n        out.append(f\"  Found at file 0x{i:05x} (ghidra ~0x{ghidra:05x}): {ctx.hex()}\")\n        count += 1\n        if count &gt; 10:\n            out.append(\"  ... (more)\")\n            break\n\nout.append(\"\")\n\n# Verify the next handler after 342 (to understand boundaries)\nout.append(\"=== Code at 0x21ED2 (next handler after 342?) ===\")\nfor l in disasm_at(data, 0x21ED2):\n    out.append(l)\n\nresult = \"\\n\".join(out)\nprint(result)\n\nwith open(\"batch5_extra.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n    f.write(result)\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
